channel.title: The Grant Desk - Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Australia, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Fellowships, Media Arts, Film & Sound, Australia, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Helpmann Fellowships 2026
    https://helpmannacademy.com.au/helpmann-fellowships/
    Helpmann Academy · deadline Closed 31 Aug 2026 · Up to AUD 7,500 per fellowship, three fellowships available. Supported by the James & Diana Ramsay Foundation. No application fee.

item.title: 1 new Media Arts, Film & Sound fellowship - week of 18 May 2026
item.description:
• Nicholas and Angela Curtis Cite Internationale des Arts Fellowships 2026 (Curtis Artist Fellowships)
    https://powerinstitute.submittable.com/submit
    Power Institute, University of Sydney · deadline Closed 30 Jun 2026 · $13,000 AUD towards travel and living costs, plus rent-free access to the Power Institute's living/working studio at the Cite Internationale des Arts for 3 months. Note: fellows pay a refundable bond deposit and utility costs. No application fee.
